new_value.description: The number the verification code is sent to. Deliberately loose: this codebase stores phone_number as given (user.json declares it as a bare string, and the SMS login flow does not validate format either), so requiring E.164 here would reject values that are already the login identifier under a PHONE policy. Normalisation is the same open question as email case-sensitivity and is tracked separately. What this pattern does enforce is what makes a value safe to hand to a sender: digits and dial punctuation only, no CR/LF, no control characters, bounded length.
